title: Measures to Transit COVID-19-related Short-term Contract Workers into Permanent Jobs
what_it_is: Measures to Transit COVID-19-related Short-term Contract Workers into Permanent Jobs

sections.label: COVID-19 short-term public sector roles
sections.summary: Over 15,000 workers were placed into public sector or Government-funded short-term roles under the SGUnited Jobs and Skills Package since COVID-19 began.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Since the start of COVID-19, over 15,000 workers have been placed into public sector or Government-funded short-term roles under the SGUnited Jobs and Skills Package to support COVID-19 operations, such as swabbing, quarantine operations, implementing safe management measures and providing patient services.

sections.label: Redeployment of short-term COVID-19 workers
sections.summary: About three in 10 workers in short-term COVID-19 roles were temporarily re-deployed under the National Jobs Council's efforts.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Among those placed into short-term COVID-19 job roles, about three in 10 were temporarily re-deployed as part of the National Jobs Council’s efforts to support workers in hard-hit areas.

sections.label: WSG and e2i placements
sections.summary: In 2020, Workforce Singapore and NTUC's e2i collectively placed close to 55,000 workers into suitable opportunities.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: In 2020, the combined efforts of Workforce Singapore (WSG) and NTUC’s Employment and Employability Institute, or e2i for short, collectively placed close to 55,000 workers into suitable opportunities.

sections.label: JGI extension and career conversion programmes
sections.summary: JGI was extended to September 2021 with support up to S$54,000 per hire, and capacity for 10,000 career conversion programme places was catered.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: JGI has been extended to September 2021 with eligible employers receiving support of up to S$54,000 per hire.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Employers who hire jobseekers who need to reskill can also tap onto the career conversion programmes and these programmes provide substantial wage and training support in addition to the JGI.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: This year, we have catered capacity for 10,000 places in these programmes.

sections.label: Task forces on growth sectors
sections.summary: Task forces chaired by the speaker identified wholesale trade, finance and infocomm as growth sectors and encourage workers to upskill or reskill.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: There are also quite a number of task forces in which I personally chair and we drive, alongside with the other sector agencies to look at growth sectors.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: We have identified three of them: the wholesale trade, finance and infocomm.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: We encourage and we nudge many of the employees and workers to actually go for upskilling or reskilling to be able to fit into these new job roles and to pivot some of the existing career opportunities into newer ones.
